text:
emily: Kicking off SparrowField POC thread. They want a 3-week technical POC focused on document Q&A + invoice parsing. Looking to confirm kickoff attendees and a tight agenda for tomorrow's call. 30 mins preferred.
ryan: I can do the customer side. Stakeholders: Head of AI (Nadia), Product (Ethan), Security Manager (Marta), Infra (Omar). They care about EU data residency and PII masking.
ben: Quick notes on scope suggestion: 1) RAG assistant over Confluence + S3 PDFs, 2) structured invoice extraction (JSON schema), 3) throughput test at 100qps for batch jobs. Latency target p95 <250ms for single-turn.
tanya: Security flags: they want encryption at rest, retention controls, and red-team logs for hallucination cases. Also they'll request our data processing agreement + a short questionnaire. I'll review when they send.
emily: Success criteria proposal: - Invoice extraction F1 > 92% on validation set - RAG answer accuracy > 88% on a 100-prompt eval - p95 latency <250ms - No PII stored beyond 7 days unless approved - Demo flow end-to-end in week 2.
ben: For evals, ask customer to provide 75 labeled invoices and 100 RAG prompts with expected answers. We'll provide a template prompt file they can fill. Example prompt style:

```
User: "What is the total due on invoice INV-2024-01?"
Context: <invoice OCR text>
Assistant: {"total_due": "12345.67", "due_date": "2024-03-01"}
```

ryan: Deployment preference: they said "prefer hosted" but will consider Dedicated if residency requires it. Omar will confirm whether VPC peering is allowed.
tanya: If they insist on EU-only hosting, we'll propose Redwood Private with customer VPC. That needs network contacts and certs. Also ask about KMS (they prefer using their key).
emily: Pricing note for SOW: for a 3-week POC with expected 1.2M tokens plus extraction batch runs, recommend offering hosted credit for trial and provide optional Dedicated quote. Ben, can you rough that out?
ben: Estimate: hosted credits option: $0 (promotional) + normal usage tracking; Dedicated quote for short-term reservation: 2x A10-like GPU pool ~ $4.5k/week (includes support + modest burst). I'll add tooling/instrumentation line item if they want extra observability retention.
ryan: Tango on legal: Marta will push for SOC2 evidence and a short data flow diagram. I'll ask them to send the security questionnaire before kickoff so Tanya can pre-scan.
emily: Discovery checklist for kickoff (short): - Primary use cases and 3 success scenarios - Data sources (Confluence, S3, Postgres?) and access method - Labeled examples count and sample schema - Residency / KMS / retention rules - Expected concurrency, avg seq length, and peak hours - Who signs off technical & business
tanya: Add to checklist: does customer require log redaction? Do they want alerts for sensitive findings? Do they mandate SIEM integration?
infra-bot: [system] infra checklist created: required fields: CIDR for peering, contact for network, KMS endpoint, allowed outbound ports. Link: https://infra.internal/poctemplates/sparrowfield
ben: Also ask if they need function/tool-calling (e.g., call invoice-processor) vs. freeform JSON. It affects validation tooling.
emily: I'll draft the SOW with the scope, timeline (week1: ingest + baseline eval; week2: model tuning & integration; week3: user validation + handoff), success criteria table, and pricing options. Will share before EOD.
ryan: I'll send calendar invite for tomorrow 11:00am CET and attach pre-reads: SOW draft, security checklist, sample prompt template.	anya: Once we get the questionnaire, I'll flag any blockers. If they require full on-prem, that escalates to Private sales lead.
ben: Action items after kickoff: within 48h run the 75-invoice extraction baseline and a 50-prompt RAG quick eval to confirm major regressions.
emily: Action items summary:
- emily: SOW + success table + pre-read (EOD)
- ryan: schedule kickoff, upload customer security questionnaire if available
- ben: prepare eval template, Dedicated cost estimate, tool-calling notes
- tanya: pre-scan security questionnaire and list blockers
- infra-bot: create private-deploy checklist link (done)

emily: Thanks team. Keep replies short if anything urgent comes from the customer thread. :white_check_mark:
